name: Volatility-conditioned dip quality
motivation: Rebound size and adverse moves both rise with volatility.
evidence: Fixed ATR bands show different return and excess behavior; higher-volatility events also suffer deeper MAE.
mechanism: Volatility changes the scale of both the dip and recovery.
features: Signal-time ATR14/close and existing V1 event.
lookahead_risk: ATR must be frozen at signal close; outcomes never choose bands.
future_test: Paired prospective outcomes by the existing diagnostic ATR bands; no filtering or policy selection.
overfitting_risk: Moderate: descriptive subgroup evidence on consumed history; simple causal input, easy to archive.

name: Rebound duration / adaptive holding
motivation: Time-only exits had higher historical EV than selected barriers.
evidence: Full ten-bar maximum favorable high often occurs several bars after entry.
mechanism: Barriers may truncate a recovery that needs time.
features: Entry timestamp, daily observed OHLC and frozen costs.
lookahead_risk: Future MFE is diagnostic only; never choose each trade's exit from it.
future_test: First validate frozen ten-bar hold versus V1 on exactly the same prospective signals; adaptive duration remains unimplemented.
status: Historical motivation mixed; prospective test proposed
overfitting_risk: Moderate: existing simple control, but no-stop exposure can increase losses.

name: Relative-to-SPY dip severity
motivation: Absolute rebounds do not establish stock-specific information.
evidence: EXP-002 breadth failed despite positive pooled event means.
mechanism: Separate market recovery from idiosyncratic weakness.
features: Existing relative return and matched-SPY outcomes.
lookahead_risk: Only trailing weakness known at the signal may describe the candidate.
future_test: Predeclared descriptive severity bands with paired prospective SPY comparisons.
overfitting_risk: Moderate: economic rationale is strong; thresholds and market dependence can overfit.

name: Falling-knife avoidance
evidence: Historical severe negative momentum does not uniformly imply worse mean outcomes; simple avoidance is not supported.
features: Existing trailing momentum, drawdown change, volume and ATR.
lookahead_risk: Stabilization must be observed before entry, never inferred from a later rebound.
future_test: One causal stabilization definition after a new registration, not a multi-filter search.
overfitting_risk: High if many correlated filters are combined; medium feasibility.

name: Component-specific dip quality
motivation: Correlated components need not add equal information.
evidence: Three/four-component and exact-combination outcomes differ, with small subgroups.
mechanism: Components describe distinct price patterns as well as shared weakness.
lookahead_risk: Do not promote the strongest historical combination into a new rule.
future_test: Validate all predeclared component combinations descriptively in prospective data.
overfitting_risk: High subgroup-selection risk; technically simple, uneven prospective counts.

name: Market-regime conditioning
motivation: Market recoveries can dominate stock behavior.
evidence: Below-SPY-average events had higher raw return but lower mean excess and deeper MAE.
mechanism: Market stress changes rebound opportunity and downside together.
features: Causal SPY trailing average, volatility, return and drawdown.
lookahead_risk: No retrospective regime labels or optimized cutoffs.
future_test: Descriptive prospective regime reports with unchanged signals.
overfitting_risk: High regime multiplicity and dependence; simple features but slow independent samples.

name: Rebound-confirmation entry
motivation: A later confirmation might avoid continued decline.
evidence: Entry-gap subgroup outcomes vary; a signal-time decision cannot know its next-open gap.
mechanism: Wait for observed stabilization at the cost of missing early rebound.
features: Completed confirmation bar and explicit later execution timestamp.
lookahead_risk: No fill before the confirming observation became available.
future_test: One registered confirmation condition and explicit missed-trade accounting.
overfitting_risk: High timing-search risk; different entries complicate paired comparison.

name: Rebound-path-based exit
motivation: Capturing opportunity and protecting losses are different objectives.
evidence: EXP-004 EV improved versus V1 but did not beat time-only EV; tail losses worsened.
mechanism: Causal evolving price structure might protect downside without truncating recovery.
features: Only bars completed before each exit decision.
lookahead_risk: Intraday order and future MFE must not be assumed known.
future_test: Separate small exit protocol after prospective control evidence; no new grid now.
overfitting_risk: High path-rule flexibility; medium feasibility, daily execution ambiguity.

name: Stock-type conditioning
evidence: Ticker-average ATR and volatility correlate with gross and excess returns.
mechanism: Business and trading characteristics may change recovery behavior.
features: Causal observable characteristics, not winning-ticker identity.
lookahead_risk: No historical winners whitelist; avoid current-sector labels as historical facts.
future_test: Objective characteristic groups only after definition and source registration.
overfitting_risk: High survivor selection and stock-specific overfit risk; provenance work needed.

name: Repeated-support memory
motivation: Earlier successful dip zones could retain information.
evidence: The recorded exploratory zone definition had lower gross return and negative SPY excess; original intuition is not confirmed.
mechanism: Repeated buying interest near a prior level, or deteriorating support on repeated visits.
features: Strictly mature prior V1 recoveries, prior low, distance and age.
lookahead_risk: Prior recovery must mature before current signal; adjusted revisions and missing earlier history matter.
future_test: Retain the current zone definition as context; no strategy or tuning until fresh evidence.
overfitting_risk: High definition flexibility and left-censoring; context collection is feasible.
